summary.text: Esther Agbaje is a Democratic member of the Minnesota House of Representatives from District 59B, where Ballotpedia lists the current tenure as beginning in 2021, and is on the ballot for re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election. Republican Kenneth Smoron is also on the general election ballot.

paragraphs.text: Esther Agbaje was born in St. Paul, Minnesota, and lives in Minneapolis, and earned a B.A. in political science from George Washington University, an M.P.A. from the University of Pennsylvania and a J.D. from Harvard University.
Her career experience includes working as an associate with the Ciresi Conlin law firm, a negotiator and a program manager.
Esther Agbaje defeated Kenneth Smoron in the November 5, 2024 general election.
Agbaje's 2025-2026 committee assignments included the Agriculture Finance and Policy Committee, the House Housing Finance and Policy Committee and the Ways and Means Committee (as Co-Vice Chair).
